simple_zh: 這些業務人員非常友善。
toeic: Our salespeople will attend a training workshop on Monday.
toeic_zh: 我們的業務人員將於週一參加培訓工作坊。

en: meeting requirements or expectations adequately
toeic: Employees with satisfactory performance reviews maintain their current salary and benefits.
toeic_zh: 績效評估令人滿意的員工保持其目前的薪水和福利。

en: money given to a student to pay for study
toeic: The firm offers a scholarship to students who study engineering.
toeic_zh: 這家公司為就讀工程的學生提供獎學金。

en: a person who is looking for something
toeic: Every job seeker should prepare a clear and short résumé.
toeic_zh: 每位求職者都應準備一份清楚簡短的履歷。

en: half of a school year
toeic: Students must pay tuition at the start of each semester.
toeic_zh: 學生必須在每學期開始時繳交學費。

en: a husband or wife
simple: His spouse works at a bank.
toeic: Employees may add a spouse to their health insurance plan.
toeic_zh: 員工可以將配偶加入健康保險計畫。

en: planned and designed to achieve specific goals
toeic: Strategic workforce planning aligns employee capabilities with organizational objectives and future growth.
toeic_zh: 戰略人力資源規劃將員工能力與組織目標和未來增長相一致。

en: better than others
toeic: Our product is superior to those of our competitors.
toeic_zh: 我們的產品優於競爭對手的產品。

en: to watch and direct people or work
toeic: Managers supervise the work of new employees.
toeic_zh: 主管負責監督新進員工的工作。

en: to end an employment relationship
toeic: Employees may be terminated for violation of company policies or unsatisfactory performance.
toeic_zh: 員工可因違反公司政策或績效不滿意而被終止。

en: the act of ending something
toeic: Early termination of the contract requires written notice.
toeic_zh: 提前終止合約需要書面通知。

en: a person who is learning a job
toeic: Each trainee will receive a mentor for the first month.
toeic_zh: 每位受訓者在第一個月都會有一位導師。

en: a person who teaches skills to others
toeic: A professional trainer will lead the safety workshop.
toeic_zh: 一位專業講師將帶領安全工作坊。

en: Money paid for classes at a school.
simple: The tuition is very high here.
toeic: The company will cover your tuition for evening courses.
toeic_zh: 公司會負擔你夜間課程的學費。

en: the rate at which employees leave a job or organization
toeic: High employee turnover increases recruitment and training costs for the organization.
toeic_zh: 高員工離職率增加了組織的招聘和培訓成本。

en: Without a job.
simple: He has been unemployed for a month.
toeic: The number of unemployed workers fell slightly last quarter.
toeic_zh: 上一季失業人數略微下降。

en: Not yet paid, or without pay.
toeic: Please settle all unpaid invoices before the end of the month.
toeic_zh: 請在月底前結清所有未付發票。

en: an unfilled job position
simple: There is a vacancy in our team.
simple_zh: 我們的團隊有一個空缺。
toeic: The company announced three job vacancies in the marketing department.
toeic_zh: 公司在市場行銷部門宣布了三個空缺。

en: A period of time away from work or school.
simple: We are on vacation this week.
toeic: Employees must submit vacation requests at least two weeks ahead.
toeic_zh: 員工須至少提前兩週提出休假申請。

en: the state of being in good physical and mental health
toeic: Comprehensive wellness programs include fitness classes, mental health support, and nutrition counseling.
toeic_zh: 全面的健康計畫包括健身課程、心理健康支持和營養諮詢。

en: The feeling of being ready to do something.
simple: I like his willingness to help.
toeic: We value your willingness to work flexible hours.
toeic_zh: 我們重視您願意彈性工作的態度。

en: A book with exercises for students.
simple: Open your workbook to page ten.
simple_zh: 請把練習本翻到第十頁。
toeic: Each trainee receives a workbook at the start of the course.
toeic_zh: 每位受訓者在課程開始時會領到一本練習手冊。

en: all the people employed in a company or industry
toeic: The company is developing strategies to attract younger talent to its aging workforce.
toeic_zh: 公司正在制定戰略以吸引年輕人才到其老化的勞動力隊伍。

en: the place where someone works
toeic: A positive workplace culture encourages collaboration, innovation, and employee satisfaction.
toeic_zh: 積極的工作場所文化鼓勵協作、創新和員工滿意度。

en: a sum of money provided for a specific purpose
toeic: Monthly allowances for transportation and meals are provided to field representatives.
toeic_zh: 為外場代表提供月度運輸和膳食津貼。

en: independence and freedom to make decisions in one's work
toeic: Giving employees autonomy in decision-making improves engagement and develops leadership capabilities.
toeic_zh: 給員工決策自主權改善參與度並發展領導能力。

en: a demonstrated ability to perform tasks
toeic: Core competencies for this role include communication and problem-solving.
toeic_zh: 公司通過定期績效評估來評估員工能力。

en: having the knowledge and ability to do something successfully
simple_zh: 他是一位有能力的工程師。
toeic: A competent workforce with strong technical skills is essential for company success.
toeic_zh: 具有強大技術技能的有能力的勞動力對公司成功至關重要。

en: a qualification or achievement showing someone's ability
simple_zh: 她的證書令人印象深刻。
toeic: Candidates should present relevant credentials such as certifications and awards.
toeic_zh: 候選人應提供相關證書，如認證和獎項。

en: unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people
toeic: Zero-tolerance discrimination policies ensure equal treatment regardless of race, gender, or age.
toeic_zh: 零容忍歧視政策確保不分種族、性別或年齡的平等待遇。

en: improvement or increase in value or quality
toeic: Career enhancement programs provide training and development opportunities to strengthen employee capabilities.
toeic_zh: 職業增強計畫提供培訓和發展機會以加強員工能力。

en: the practice of including and welcoming all people
simple_zh: 包容是公司的優先事項。
toeic: Inclusion of diverse perspectives strengthens team outcomes.
toeic_zh: 包容性的工作場所文化歡迎多元化員工並提供平等的晉升機會。

en: process of making something as good or effective as possible
toeic: Continuous optimization of workflows and systems increases employee productivity and organizational effectiveness.
toeic_zh: 工作流程和系統的持續優化提高了員工生產力和組織有效性。

en: to pay another company to do work for you
toeic: The firm chose to outsource its payroll processing to a specialist.
toeic_zh: 公司選擇將薪資處理外包給專業業者。

en: to cause someone to suffer a penalty for wrongdoing
toeic: The company punishes violations of workplace conduct policies through warnings or suspension.
toeic_zh: 公司通過警告或暫停來懲罰違反工作場所行為政策的行為。

en: the period of time someone holds a job
simple: His tenure here is ten years.
toeic: During her tenure as HR director, staff turnover fell sharply.
toeic_zh: 在她擔任人資主管期間，員工流動率大幅下降。

en: Good enough; of acceptable quality.
toeic: The hotel offers decent rooms at a reasonable price.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店以合理價格提供不錯的客房。

en: Dishonest or illegal behavior by powerful people.
toeic: The audit uncovered corruption within the purchasing department.
toeic_zh: 稽核發現採購部門內部有貪腐情事。

en: Developing step by step; favoring change.
toeic: The firm adopted a progressive pay system to reward performance.
toeic_zh: 公司採用漸進式薪資制度來獎勵績效。

en: Something done to a person who broke a rule.
toeic: The policy lists the punishment for late reports and missed deadlines.
toeic_zh: 政策列出了延遲報告與錯過期限的處罰。

en: The study of the mind and behavior.
toeic: Consumer psychology helps marketers understand buying habits.
toeic_zh: 消費者心理學幫助行銷人員了解購買習慣。

en: able to learn and understand things well
toeic: We hired an intelligent analyst to review the market data.
toeic_zh: 我們聘請了一位聰明的分析師來檢視市場數據。

en: having two parts or purposes
toeic: The new role has a dual responsibility for sales and service.
toeic_zh: 這個新職位同時負責銷售與服務兩部分。

en: the state of being equal in rights
simple: We believe in equality for all.
toeic: The firm promotes gender equality in hiring and pay.
toeic_zh: 公司在聘雇與薪資上推動性別平等。

en: including many different types
simple_zh: 我們有一支多元的團隊。
toeic: The company serves a diverse range of clients worldwide.
toeic_zh: 公司服務全球各種不同的客戶。

en: at an earlier time
toeic: Mr. Lee, formerly of Sales, is now our operations director.
toeic_zh: 李先生先前任職業務部，現為我們的營運總監。

en: to get rid of something
toeic: The company plans to shed 200 jobs this year.
toeic_zh: 公司計劃今年裁減兩百個職位。

en: a condition that limits what a person can do
toeic: The building provides full access for people with a disability.
toeic_zh: 這棟大樓為身心障礙者提供完整的無障礙設施。

en: in a way allowed by law
simple: You must legally sign the form.
simple_zh: 你必須依法簽署這份表格。
toeic: The firm is legally required to protect customer data.
toeic_zh: 公司依法必須保護客戶資料。

en: not treating people equally or fairly
toeic: Employees filed a complaint about unfair treatment.
toeic_zh: 員工針對不公平待遇提出申訴。

en: the position or term of a president
toeic: She took over the presidency of the company last month.
toeic_zh: 她上個月接任公司總裁職位。

en: a room where students learn
toeic: The training will be held in the classroom on the third floor.
toeic_zh: 訓練將在三樓的教室舉行。

en: related to thinking and understanding
simple: Reading helps cognitive growth in children.
simple_zh: 閱讀有助於兒童的認知發展。
toeic: The training program improves cognitive skills such as problem solving.
toeic_zh: 這個訓練課程可提升解決問題等認知能力。

en: a small number or amount
simple: Only a handful of people came.
toeic: Only a handful of applicants met all the requirements.
toeic_zh: 只有少數應徵者符合所有條件。

en: the legal status of belonging to a country
toeic: Applicants must show proof of citizenship or a valid work visa.
toeic_zh: 應徵者必須提供公民身分證明或有效的工作簽證。

en: right and fair according to moral rules
simple: It is not ethical to lie.
toeic: All staff must follow the company's ethical standards.
toeic_zh: 所有員工都必須遵守公司的道德標準。

en: involving a lot of work in a short time
simple: I took an intensive English course.
simple_zh: 我上了一個英語密集課程。
toeic: New staff must complete an intensive training program.
toeic_zh: 新進員工必須完成密集的訓練課程。

en: the part of a shirt around the neck
simple_zh: 他的襯衫領子是白色的。
toeic: Many white-collar workers now work from home.
toeic_zh: 許多白領工作者現在在家上班。

en: between beginner and advanced level
simple: I am an intermediate English learner.
simple_zh: 我是中級的英語學習者。
toeic: The course is designed for intermediate users of the software.
toeic_zh: 這門課是為軟體中級使用者設計的。

en: a person who takes over a job from someone
simple: Who is his successor at work?
simple_zh: 誰是他工作上的接班人？
toeic: The board will name a successor to the retiring CEO next week.
toeic_zh: 董事會將於下週宣布即將退休的執行長之繼任人選。

en: a series of things in order; taking over a position
simple: He won three games in succession.
toeic: A clear succession plan helps the firm avoid leadership gaps.
toeic_zh: 明確的接班計畫有助於公司避免領導空窗。

en: to make people obey a rule or law
simple: The school will enforce the rule.
toeic: Inspectors will enforce the new safety regulations strictly.
toeic_zh: 檢查人員將嚴格執行新的安全法規。

en: the reason why someone does something
toeic: The investigator looked for a motive behind the data leak.
toeic_zh: 調查人員尋找資料外洩背後的動機。

en: to let someone go or release something
simple: The hospital will discharge him today.
toeic: The factory was fined for the illegal discharge of waste.
toeic_zh: 該工廠因將廢棄物排入河中而被罰款。

en: an unfair difference between groups of people
simple_zh: 這裡有收入不平等的問題。
toeic: The report highlights pay inequality between men and women.
toeic_zh: 該報告凸顯了男女薪資不平等。

en: a strong wish to succeed or achieve something
toeic: His ambition is to become the regional sales director.
toeic_zh: 他的抱負是成為區域銷售總監。

en: in a way that many people could say is true
simple: This is arguably the best cafe.
simple_zh: 這可以說是最棒的咖啡館。
toeic: She is arguably the most qualified candidate for the position.
toeic_zh: 可以說她是這個職位最合格的人選。

en: a person who will receive money or property from someone
simple: He is the heir to the farm.
simple_zh: 他是這座農場的繼承人。
toeic: The founder named his daughter as heir to the family business.
toeic_zh: 創辦人指定女兒為家族事業的繼承人。

en: choosing carefully only some things or people
toeic: The company is highly selective when hiring new engineers.
toeic_zh: 該公司在招聘新工程師時非常挑剔。

en: The outer edge of something; extra benefits
simple: He lives on the city fringe.
toeic: The job offers good fringe benefits, including health insurance.
toeic_zh: 這份工作提供良好的額外福利，包括健康保險。

en: A person who held a job before someone else
simple_zh: 我的前任留了一張字條。
toeic: My predecessor set up the filing system we still use.
toeic_zh: 我的前任建立了我們至今仍在使用的歸檔系統。

en: An unfair opinion formed without enough knowledge
toeic: The company has a strict policy against prejudice in hiring.
toeic_zh: 公司有嚴格的政策禁止招聘中的偏見。

en: Based on personal feelings, not facts
toeic: Performance reviews should not be too subjective.
toeic_zh: 績效評核不應太過主觀。

en: An earlier case used as an example
toeic: The ruling set a precedent for future contract disputes.
toeic_zh: 該裁決為日後的合約糾紛樹立了先例。

en: The quality of treating people equally
toeic: The union demanded fairness in the way bonuses are given.
toeic_zh: 工會要求獎金發放要公平。

en: A person who currently holds a position
simple: The incumbent will keep the job.
simple_zh: 現任者將保有這份工作。
toeic: The incumbent manager plans to retire next year.
toeic_zh: 現任經理計劃明年退休。

en: required or set by law
simple: Statutory leave is a right by law.
simple_zh: 法定假是依法享有的權利。
toeic: Employees are entitled to statutory holidays in addition to their annual leave.
toeic_zh: 員工除了年假之外，還享有法定假日。

en: a person who moves to another place for work
simple: The migrant came here to find work.
simple_zh: 這位移工來這裡找工作。
toeic: Many migrant workers send part of their salary back home each month.
toeic_zh: 許多移工每月把部分薪水寄回家鄉。

en: using careful study to understand something
toeic: The position requires strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
toeic_zh: 這個職位需要很強的分析能力與細心。

en: the act of removing someone from a job
simple_zh: 他被解僱讓大家很驚訝。
toeic: The employee filed a complaint about his unfair dismissal.
toeic_zh: 該名員工針對不當解僱提出申訴。

en: required by a rule or law
toeic: Attendance at the safety training is compulsory for all new staff.
toeic_zh: 所有新進員工都必須參加安全訓練。

en: depending on something else happening
simple: The trip is contingent on the weather.
toeic: The offer is contingent upon a successful background check.
toeic_zh: 這份聘書以通過背景調查為條件。

en: a particular quality of a person or thing
toeic: Leadership is an important trait for a team manager.
toeic_zh: 領導力是團隊經理的重要特質。

en: a person who works in a profession
simple: My aunt is a medical practitioner.
toeic: Legal practitioners attended the seminar on new regulations.
toeic_zh: 法律從業人員參加了關於新法規的研討會。

en: depending on something else happening
toeic: The job offer is conditional on a successful background check.
toeic_zh: 這份工作錄取以通過背景調查為條件。

en: a person who is not part of a group
simple_zh: 他覺得自己像個局外人。
toeic: The company hired an outsider as its new CEO.
toeic_zh: 公司聘請了外部人士擔任新任執行長。

en: giving people more power or control
toeic: Employee empowerment improved morale and productivity.
toeic_zh: 員工賦權提升了士氣與生產力。

en: careful and steady hard work
toeic: Due diligence is required before signing the deal.
toeic_zh: 簽約前需要進行盡職調查。

en: to treat people unfairly because of who they are
toeic: The law forbids employers to discriminate on the basis of age.
toeic_zh: 法律禁止雇主以年齡為由歧視員工。

en: to give someone the power to do something
simple_zh: 好老師能賦予學生力量。
toeic: We empower our staff to solve customer problems quickly.
toeic_zh: 我們授權員工快速解決客戶問題。
